$comment: schema_version 0.1.0; tracks design/spec/eval-result-v0.md. Validates the JSON output of a NovaFabric benchmark eval run (e.g. GAIA, SWE-bench, AgentBench). Extends the OpenLineage DataQualityMetrics facet pattern. Required by v0.9 Standard Eval Suites.
title: EvalResult
description: Output record of a single benchmark eval run against a Run Capsule. Captures suite identity, OCI image digest for reproducibility, per-metric outcomes, and optional statistical context.

suite_id.description: Identifier for the benchmark suite, e.g. 'gaia', 'swe-bench-verified', 'agentbench'.

suite_version.description: Version of the benchmark suite used for this eval, e.g. '2024-06', '1.0.0'.

oci_digest.description: Pinned OCI image digest of the eval container. Ensures bit-exact reproducibility of the evaluation environment.

run_at.description: UTC timestamp when the eval run started (RFC 3339).

capsule_id.description: ID of the Run Capsule being evaluated. Typically a ULID matching run_id in the capsule manifest.

passed.description: Overall pass/fail outcome of the eval run. True only when all required metrics pass their thresholds.

metrics.description: Per-metric outcomes. Must contain at least one metric.

statistical_context.description: Optional statistical metadata for the eval run (sample size, confidence interval, p-value).

notes.description: Free-form human-readable notes about the eval run, e.g. environment caveats or known limitations.

Metric.description: A single measured metric from the eval run.

unit.description: Unit of the metric value, e.g. 'percent', 'score', 'count', 'ratio'.

threshold.description: Minimum acceptable value for the metric to be considered passing.

passed.description: True when value >= threshold for this metric.

StatisticalContext.description: Statistical metadata for interpreting eval results. All fields are optional.

sample_size.description: Number of examples or tasks evaluated.

confidence_interval.description: Two-element array [lower, upper] representing the confidence interval for the primary metric.

p_value.description: Statistical p-value for the eval result. Must be in [0, 1].
